plate.comment:
Advance a Niagara system instance, including requested reset/reinitialization and desired-age stepping.

Parameters:
- pSystemInstance: borrowed instance in RCX; generic pointer because the full instance layout is not recovered here.
- fDeltaSeconds: frame delta in XMM1 (saved to XMM6 at 141BCC8F2), not an integer RDX argument.

Algorithm:
Mode +0x50 == 0 forwards the frame delta to 141BCE060 after full reinitialization (141BC8620, flag +0x62) or reset (141BCADC0, flag +0x61). Other modes compare current age +0x54 with desired age +0x58, reset on backwards age, and advance in +0x5C steps with a one-second accumulated step limit before a final remainder update. Equal ages still call 141BCE060 with zero delta.

Returns: void.

Side effects / rollback dependency:
Full reinitialization calls interface rebinding141BCF750 and tick-list rebuilding141BC4D90 during the component update. The caller141BCDB90 checks the active component and system pointer; neither establishes an immutable static-mesh-source binding. An initializer-only guard does not close repeated or rebound Niagara transform readers. No cancellation or motion exclusion contract is established here.

Special Cases:
Saved XMM6/XMM7 stack arrays are register-save artifacts, not owned instance data. Floating register temporaries retain decompiler names. Native disassembly and the component caller verified2026-09-23.

limitation: No full instance type recovered; register temporaries retain decompiler names. Native path evidence only; G1 enforcement remains open.
